text_block_list.text:
A few days after the mock race with Tamamo Cross—
I spotted Oguri Cap training with fierce dedication.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Alright, just one more set...!

Her leg power is as magnificent as ever,
practically gouging into the turf...!

Mesmerized by her intense workout,
I couldn't help but stop and watch—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you...
choice_data_list: Good work out there. You're really fired up.
Good work out there. You're really fired up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...The truth is, I was told
I can run in the next Selection Race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The registration deadline had already passed
by the time I transferred here, but—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Apparently someone from the academy saw my race
against Tama the other day and made a special exception for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Selection Race brings my Central debut that much closer.
...I must make sure I'm in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... I'm sorry to keep imposing on you,
but could I ask you to show me around again?
choice_data_list: Where would you like to go?
Where would you like to go?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Somewhere nearby with as much greenery and nature as possible, please.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there were woods like this right behind the academy... What a great discovery.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The forest air really is wonderful.
It clears my mind and brings me peace.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, I'd run through places just like this all the time. Seeing that, the folks
back home suggested I try running in Umamusume races.
choice_data_list: So that's how you got started with racing.
So that's how you got started with racing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Everyone rallied behind me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The day of my first regional race, they made me a magnificent
banner. ...Even though they were all busy working in the fields.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Every night after a race, everyone would gather around to share a feast.
Whether I won or lost.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That was so much fun!" "You cheered us all up!" "Keep enjoying your running!"
...I was always surrounded by kind words like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I love running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just love competing in races
and bringing joy and excitement to everyone.
choice_data_list: The folks back home truly mean the world to you.
The folks back home truly mean the world to you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course they do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone back home told me,
"Nothing makes us happier than seeing you run with a smile on your face."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That race with Tama the other day... was so much fun.
Even now, just thinking about it makes my heart beat faster.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If making my debut means I can run exciting races
against strong, fast rivals like Tama—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Then I want to make my debut as soon as possible.

As Oguri Cap spoke, her eyes gleamed
with fierce determination—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I've spent too much time talking.
I need to get back to my training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for guiding me here, it was a big help.
Running here will help me reconnect with where I began.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then, excuse me.

With that, Oguri Cap briskly jogged away.
However—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Oguri Cap suddenly crouched down
right where she was!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? 
What's wrong? Why do you look so panicked?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... No, that's not it.
My shoelace just snapped.

Taking a closer look at what she pointed to,
Oguri Cap's running shoes were quite worn and battered.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's always been like this.
I tend to wear out my shoes very quickly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll have to go buy another replacement pair...

After tying the laces back together,
Oguri Cap resumed running.

Still, the state of those shoes is abnormal. Ordinary shoes likely
can't withstand the immense power of her ground-gouging strides.

At this rate, Oguri Cap might never be able
to unleash her full potential.
In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, everything here's as crazy expensive as ever...
Talk about a rip-off...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Ain't you that rookie Trainer
who's always hangin' around Oguri lately?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...What's with the weird look on yer mug?
Somethin' happen?
I explained the situation to Tamamo Cross...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I getcha. Seriously though, Oguri hadn't
even noticed herself...? She really is a total space cadet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! I'll help ya out! The Selection Race is where ya show
everythin' ya got to the Trainers. Wouldn't be fair to leave her like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll help ya pick out the toughest,
most indestructible pair of shoes in the shop!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aww, don't sweat it, don't sweat it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She's gotta go all out so she can debut ASAP.
'Sides, I got my own selfish reason—I wanna race her again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's go pick 'em out!
So, what's your budget? Ain't that the most important part!?

With Tamamo Cross's help,
I picked out a pair of shoes that could withstand Oguri Cap's running...
